poem.author: 李白
englishLines: The Tianmen peaks part where the great river breaks through,
Emerald water flows east, then turns back here.
Green mountains rise facing each other on both banks,
A lone sail comes from the edge of the sun.

appreciation.zh: 长江从两座青山之间奔涌而出，碧水在山势前回旋。诗人乘船向前，两岸山峰仿佛迎面走来，远处一叶白帆从阳光里出现。
appreciation.en: The great river surges between facing green peaks and swirls around their shape. As the boat advances, mountains seem to approach and a lone sail emerges from the sunlight.

pages.zhText:
天门中断楚江开，
碧水东流至此回。
两岸青山相对出，
孤帆一片日边来。
pages.enText:
The Tianmen peaks part where the great river breaks through,
Emerald water flows east, then turns back here.
Green mountains rise facing each other on both banks,
A lone sail comes from the edge of the sun.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Majestic yet child-friendly Tang river journey through two facing green Tianmen peaks, broad emerald water swirls gently, a small boat carries a joyful young Tang poet in white and blue robe, distant single white sail appears in golden sunlight, no text.

pages.zhText:
天门中断楚江开，
两座大山像一扇打开的门，让奔流的长江从中穿过。
pages.enText:
The Tianmen peaks part where the great river breaks through.
Two great mountains open like a gate for the river.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Low boat-level view of same two green peaks forming a dramatic natural gate, same poet's boat safely approaching on broad calm-edged river, cliffs high but not threatening, no literal door or text.

pages.zhText:
碧水东流至此回。
碧绿的江水一路向东，来到山前又转出一弯明亮的水纹。
pages.enText:
Emerald water flows east, then turns back here.
At the mountains, the green river curls into a bright sweeping bend.
pages.illustrationPrompt: High three-quarter view of same emerald river making a strong graceful curve between peaks, visible layered currents around safe poet boat, mineral blue-green focal color, no dangerous rapids or text.

pages.zhText:
两岸青山相对出，
船向前走，两岸的青山好像一座接一座迎面出来。
pages.enText:
Green mountains rise facing each other on both banks.
As the boat moves, mountains seem to step forward in welcome.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Forward-facing view from same boat, layered green mountains on both banks appear to unfold toward viewer, poet stands balanced under small canopy with delighted gaze, no text.

pages.zhText:
孤帆一片日边来。
远远的阳光里，一叶白帆慢慢靠近，给大江添上一点轻盈。
pages.enText:
A lone sail comes from the edge of the sun.
A white sail glides from the distant sunlight across the great river.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Long luminous river view, exactly one distant white sail emerges from round golden sunlight near horizon, same poet watches from nearer boat, clear safe distance, no duplicate sails or text.

pages.zhText: 山打开，水回旋，船向前。诗里的每一样景物都在动，整条大江像一幅慢慢展开的长画。
pages.enText: Mountains open, water turns, and boats move. The whole river becomes a long painting unfolding in motion.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Panoramic unfolding river composition connecting natural mountain gate, turning current, poet boat and distant sail in one sweeping visual path, airy grandeur, no text.

pages.zhText: 诗人不是站在岸上看山，而是坐在船上迎向它。难怪山峰、江水和白帆都显得这样有生命。
pages.enText: The poet does not watch from shore; he sails toward the mountains. That is why peaks, water, and sail all seem alive.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Dynamic close view of same joyful poet at bow with robe and hair ribbon lifted by river breeze, facing great green peaks and sparkling current, secure railing and calm posture, no text.

pages.zhText:
天门中断楚江开，
碧水东流至此回。
两岸青山相对出，
孤帆一片日边来。
再轻轻读一遍吧。
pages.enText:
The Tianmen peaks part where the great river breaks through,
Emerald water flows east, then turns back here.
Green mountains rise facing each other on both banks,
A lone sail comes from the edge of the sun.
Now read it softly once more.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Closing golden panorama beyond the mountain gate, same poet boat and single white sail share broad emerald river at safe distance, peaks glow in late sun, no text.
